counterfactual_missing_items: No raw span confirms the bladder wall thickening is truly malignant rather than merely suspicious
No raw span indicates the nephrolithiasis is obstructive or acutely symptomatic; it is explicitly non-obstructing
No raw span places CMV in the current acute syndrome; valganciclovir and viremia are background/prophylaxis
decisive_items: Blood and urine cultures grow Escherichia coli
Urinalysis is positive for leukocyte esterase, nitrites, and white blood cells
fever, left-sided flank pain, and foul-smelling urine
response.rationale: C1 is the composite of R2 plus the culture-identified organism, making it the most complete acute diagnosis. R2 already has the same culture span but stops at the generic UTI label. R4 and R5 are ancillary imaging findings, while R3 has no raw support for current CMV disease.

rejected.why: Non-obstructing stone does not explain fever, pyuria, leukocytosis, or E. coli growth.
Bladder wall thickening is only suspicious and does not explain the acute infectious syndrome.
CMV has no raw support as the current cause; valganciclovir is background/prophylaxis.
